firm_data.firm_description: Hamilton Clarke is an elite boutique law firm that represents clients in high-stakes Corporate and Shareholder Activism, Commercial and Civil Litigation, and White Collar and Criminal Defense matters. HC brings sophistication, experience, and relentlessness to each matter.
notable_facts: Clients include Fortune 500 companies, technology companies, startups, leading hedge and private funds, c-suite executives, board of directors and special committees, and high profile celebrities, politicians and professional athletes.
The firm was founded by attorneys from The Bronx Defenders and The Legal Aid Society of New York.

additional_contacts.name: Stacey J. Clarke
additional_contacts.title: Firm Administrator & Executive Director of Community Engagement

email.subject: AI for Hamilton Clarke, LLP
email.body:
Hi Brooks,

Hamilton Clarke's white-collar and investigations work across Fortune 500 companies and c-suite executives demands precision under pressure. That's exactly the constraint we solve for.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
